title: First Vaccinations
desc: Rotavirus, DTaP-IPV-Hep B/Hib, and PCV13 — brave as could be, and celebrated with lots of cuddles after.
story: Six weeks old and it was time for your first round of vaccinations. The nurse was warm and efficient, and warned us it would be over in seconds. She was right — but those seconds were tough. You cried a proper cry, red-faced and furious, and Mum held you tight immediately. Within a minute you had settled, already forgetting what the fuss was about. We were proud of you — and maybe needed the cuddles just as much as you did.
